result.summary: Bypasses the `std::locale("")` check in `SetupEnvironment()` when building on illumos-based platforms. This prevents node startup crashes caused by an upstream libstdc++ bug in certain illumos GCC toolchains.
result.problem: On illumos-based distributions like OmniOS or OpenIndiana where GCC is built with `--enable-clocale=dragonfly`, `std::ctype<char>::~ctype()` passes an uninitialized pointer to `freelocale()`. As a result, instantiating `std::locale("")` during initialization intermittently crashes Bitcoin Core on startup with memory corruption errors.
evidence: Commit description: 'Constructing and destroying `std::locale("")` in `SetupEnvironment()` therefore intermittently crashes, e.g. with "libc thread failure: lfree() called with a misaligned pointer"'.
Links upstream tracking issues in GCC for illumos (illumos/gcc#56), omnios-build#4253, and illumos bug #18481.
result.scope_notes: A very small platform-specific `#ifdef` check in initialization code (+4/-1 lines).
result.card: Bypasses the environment locale validation check during startup on illumos-based operating systems. On illumos distributions whose GCC uses dragon-fly clocale support, destroying std::locale instances triggers an upstream bug where an uninitialized pointer is passed to freelocale(), causing intermittent startup crashes. Bypassing the check resolves crashes on illumos without affecting other platforms.

risk.why: Only affects illumos-specific initialization and bypasses an environment locale check.
